# certloom_team (Resource)

A team that owns certificate lineages and endpoints. Findings and alerts are routed by owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "certloom_team" "platform" {
  name    = "platform"
  contact = "platform-oncall@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique team name.

### Optional

- `contact` (String) How to reach the team, for example an email address or chat channel.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by certloom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id, as shown by the certloom CLI or API.
terraform import certloom_team.example <id>
```
